c: Prepare and weigh the fruit; macerate with half the sugar 12 h at 4 °C (draws juice, firmer fruit).
Crush one third of the berries to release pectin; add zest.
Heat to 40 °C; whisk in pectin mixed with 10 × its weight of sugar; boil 1 min.
Add remaining sugar in two additions, returning to the boil each time; skim.
Boil hard to 104 °C / 65 °Brix (8–12 min); add acid at the end. Setting test: drop on a frozen plate, chill 1 min, push with a finger: it should wrinkle. Refractometer 65 °Brix (jam) / 104–104.5 °C.
Rest 5 min (fruit stays suspended); fill hot.
